name: qualitati
description: Run AI-moderated interviews, conversational surveys and qualitative analysis on QualiTaTi from your AI agent.

interface.shortDescription: Run AI-moderated interviews, conversational surveys and qualitative analysis on QualiTaTi from your AI agent.
interface.longDescription: QualiTaTi is an AI-powered qualitative research platform. This plugin connects your agent to the hosted QualiTaTi MCP server so it can create AI-interview studies and surveys, hand out participant links, read transcripts, run coding and quality analysis, and summarise results — with the same API key, permissions and billing as your QualiTaTi account.
defaultPrompt: Set up a semi-structured interview study on QualiTaTi about onboarding friction and give me the participant link.
Summarise the themes across the completed interviews in my QualiTaTi project.
